test_mode: direct production MCP; conversational activation and refusal not tested

result.instructions: VendorGuard compares commercial quotes and hidden cost drivers. It does not invent missing fees or contractual terms.

tools.name: normalize_vendor_quote
tools.description: Normalize a vendor quote into total cost of ownership over a stated term using only supplied commercial assumptions. Use once per vendor before comparing options.
tools.title: normalize vendor quote

positive.prompt:
Vendor A charges $1,000 setup plus $500 per month for 12 months. What is the real cost?

Synthetic reviewer inputs: {"monthly_fee": 500, "one_time_fee": 1000, "term_months": 12}. All unlisted optional monetary costs are confirmed zero for this test; all currencies are USD unless stated. Use these supplied values, keep policy/contract verification separate, and expose assumptions.

content.text: {"currency":"USD","term_months":12,"one_time_cost":1000,"recurring_cost":6000,"expected_exit_cost":0,"total_cost_of_ownership":7000,"effective_monthly_cost":583.33,"note":"TCO uses only the supplied commercial assumptions. Compare scope coverage, service levels, exclusions, renewal terms, usage caps, and lock-in separately."}

structuredContent.note: TCO uses only the supplied commercial assumptions. Compare scope coverage, service levels, exclusions, renewal terms, usage caps, and lock-in separately.
